name: Sanctions & coercion
value: OFAC actions 9 Nov; France seeks EU Iran curbs
summary: OFAC published new sanctions actions on 9 Nov; France says it will seek EU sanctions on Iran over a cyberattack
state: The US Treasury's sanctions office published a notice of new sanctions actions in the Federal Register on 9 Nov, following Iran-related shipping, aviation and digital-asset listings on 5–6 Nov. France said on 9 Nov it will seek EU-level sanctions on Iran after attributing a cyberattack on supermarkets to a Revolutionary Guards unit (Al Jazeera). No major economy has been cut off from payment systems and no large seizure of sovereign assets was found.
for_you: New listings mainly affect firms trading with Iran and Russia. Businesses with exposure there should check OFSI and OFAC lists; there is no direct effect on most households.
rubric_hit: Major new packages and secondary-sanction pressure on Iran; no major economy cut off
